d: We are far more than a worldwide leader in hospitality. We welcome you as you are and offer opportunities to find a role and brand that truly match your personality and aspirations. At Ennismore, we are committed to supporting your growth and learning every day, ensuring that your work brings purpose and fulfillment to your life. During your journey with us, you will have the opportunity to explore limitless possibilities, shape your own story, and help us imagine the future of hospitality together.

Rixos Murjana is a self-contained paradise where everything you desire is effortlessly within reach. Consistently offering guests hospitality experiences that transcend the ordinary, this new Rixos Hotels’ property in Saudi Arabia is set to redefine hotel stays in the Kingdom. Spanning 275,000 square metres, the very best of indulgence, relaxation, and adventure come together in an All-Inclusive experience like no other- all-encompassing, uncompromising, and unmatched.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communications, Graphic Design, or a related field.
Minimum 2-3 years of relevant experience in content creation, digital marketing, or social media management, preferably within a 4- or 5-star hotel or hospitality environment.
Experience in photography, videography, and video editing.
Proficiency in content creation and editing tools, such as Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut, or equivalent software.
Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital content trends, and audience engagement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Arabic is an advantage.
Creative mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
r: Under the general direction of the Director of Marketing and within the limits of established Rixos Hotel policies and procedures, the Content Creator (Executive) is responsible for developing, creating, and managing engaging digital content that supports the hotel's marketing objectives, strengthens brand awareness, and enhances its online presence. The role ensures that all content reflects the Rixos brand identity, maintains high-quality standards, and effectively communicates the hotel's facilities, services, experiences, and promotional activities across relevant digital platforms.
Develop and implement content plans and calendars in coordination with the Director of Marketing, ensuring alignment with the hotel's marketing objectives and promotional activities.
Create, edit, and publish engaging content for the hotel's social media platforms, website, and other digital marketing channels.
Produce high-quality visual and written content, including photography, videography, reels, stories, captions, and promotional materials.
Capture and showcase the hotel's facilities, guest experiences, dining concepts, events, activities, and seasonal promotions.
Coordinate with relevant departments to obtain information, arrange content shoots, and ensure accurate representation of hotel services and offerings.
Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop creative concepts, campaign ideas, and content that supports the hotel's brand positioning.
Ensure all content is consistent with Rixos brand guidelines, tone of voice, and visual identity.
Monitor social media trends, industry developments, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for creative and relevant content.
Support the execution of marketing campaigns, hotel events, promotional activities, and special occasions through content creation.
Review and edit content to ensure accuracy, quality, consistency, and suitability for the intended audience.
Ensure all published content complies with applicable copyright, data protection, and brand requirements.
Maintain an organized library of photographs, videos, and other marketing materials for future use.
Monitor content performance and engagement across digital platforms and provide insights and recommendations for improvement.
Coordinate with external photographers, videographers, influencers, and other creative partners when required.
Perform any other duties related to the position as assigned by the Director of Marketing.
Marketing Operational Standards, Policy & Procedure Adherence
Ensure all content creation and marketing activities comply with established Rixos Hotel policies, procedures, and brand standards.
Maintain consistency in the hotel's communication, visual identity, and digital presence.
Ensure all content is reviewed and approved in accordance with the hotel's marketing procedures before publication.
Promote a positive and professional image of the hotel through all content and communication channels.
Mandatory ISO Integrated Management System (IMS) Compliance

It is the responsibility of all employees at Rixos Murjana to adhere to the established ISO Integrated Management System, including Quality, LQA, Environment, Health, Safety and Risk Management, Food Safety Management System, and Customer Complaint Handling Management System (ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, and 10002), as well as applicable policies, procedures, manuals, SOPs, and legal requirements.

The employee is expected and strongly encouraged to participate in and contribute to the comprehensive risk management program, environmental impact assessment, pollution prevention, energy and water-saving initiatives, quality enhancement, guest satisfaction, and continual improvement plans.
